commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' Ath Bilbao couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
90+1' Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to Ivan Martin (Girona) for a tough tackle.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
86' Michel has decided to make a change. Lass Kourouma (Girona) replaces Hugo Rincon.
86' Substitution. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Vladyslav Vanat walks off.
85' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
85' The attendance is 45739.

83' Ambitious effort from Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post.
82' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
81' It's time for a substitution. Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) comes on in place of Oihan Sancet.
79' The linesman signals that Yaser Asprilla (Girona) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
76' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arnau Martinez (Girona) replacing Bryan Gil.

71' The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
70' The referee points to the corner flag and Ath Bilbao will take a corner.

70' What a great chance for Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
70' The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
68' Jose Munuera shows the yellow card to Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) for a heavy challenge.
67' Jose Munuera has a clear sight and sees a foul from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao).
65' That's an easy save for Unai Simon, following a first time shot towards the middle of the goal from Alejandro Frances (Girona).
64' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.

53' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the left post.
48' 1 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
46' Half-time substitution. Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) will not participate anymore and Jesus Areso is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Jon Aspiazu decided to make a change. Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) is replaced by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jon Aspiazu gives a chance to Yuri Berchiche and Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) is off.

45' Surely that's handball by one of the Ath Bilbao players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
45' Portu (Girona) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
43' Ath Bilbao take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
43' The free kick is delivered by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. Ath Bilbao force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
43' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Ivan Martin (Girona) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Ath Bilbao have a free kick.
42' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
40' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alex Moreno (Girona) heads on.

37' Portu (Girona) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
36' The resulting free kick from Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
36' Ivan Martin (Girona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Munuera blows for a foul. A free kick to Ath Bilbao.
34' Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) rises above the defending players to meet the corner kick. His header goes to the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga is alert and manages to keep the ball out.
33' Michel is forced to make a change. Donny van de Beek (Girona) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Portu.
33' Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
33' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
30' Donny van de Beek (Girona) picks up an injury.
28' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
26' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
24' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar.
22' Ivan Martin (Girona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
21' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts the ball.
21' Ath Bilbao take a short corner kick.

21' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.
20' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!
19' One of the Girona players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Ath Bilbao will take a free kick.
16' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar.
15' Bryan Gil (Girona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
14' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Bryan Gil (Girona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
14' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Girona win a corner.
12' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao).
11' What a miskick by Donny van de Beek (Girona). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
10' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.

9' 0 - 1 Sensational! Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box onto the underside of the crossbar and into the net. The assist goes to Bryan Gil and the score changes to 0:1.
8' What a sensational goal that would have been! Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) picks up the ball inside the box and fires a beautiful first-time shot, but it goes just a few inches wide of the right post.
7' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
7' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
6' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner.
